In [[geometry]], the '''truncated hexagonal trapezohedron''' is the fourth in an infinite series of [[truncated trapezohedra]]. It has 12 [[pentagon]] and 2 [[hexagon]] faces. It can be constructed by taking a [[hexagonal trapezohedron]] and [[Truncation (geometry)|truncating]] the polar axis vertices.

== Weaire–Phelan structure ==
The [[Weaire–Phelan structure]] contains another form of this polyhedron that has ''D''<sub>''2d''</sub> symmetry and is a part of a [[honeycomb (geometry)|space-filling honeycomb]] along with an irregular [[dodecahedron]].
